definition.name: Copy Area Parameter Between Models by Level and Name
definition.description: Copies a text parameter (by parameter id) from one open model's areas of a scheme to another open model's areas, matched by level and area name.
definition.aiDescription: Copies a text parameter (by parameter id) from one open model's areas of a scheme to another open model's areas, matched by level and area name.
examples: copy an area parameter from one open model to another by level and area name
